Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
On Jun 19, 12:08 pm, suoli <suoliruse...@gmail.com> wrote:
> On 19 kesä, 19:49, XZealot <xzea...@cox.net> wrote:
>
> > I am not sold on Garibaldi-Meucci Museum i a rush deck.
>
> It's mainly for abusing Reformation and Shattering. Hosers + recursion
> is surprisingly strong.

Garibaldi-Meucci Museam is excellent in Ian decks that play all the
anarch cards, but in this deck the Ashur Tablets seemed to work well
for me.

How would you offset the two pool swing between a Ashur Tablet and a
Garibaldi-Meucci recursion?

FYI, getting 12 cards back into my deck was really really strong for
this deck. At the end of the game I was at 40 cards left in my
library which means that after using 2 sets of ashur tablet I would
have been down to about 16 cards left in my library. This may not seem
bad, but for a deck that rushes constantly it means that I would have
almost no combat cards left to play.
